title: Gold Prices Drop Significantly Over Two Days
excerpt: Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a steep decline, falling by Rs. 18,900 per tola over a two-day period.
body_html: Gold prices experienced a significant decline over a two-day period, dropping by a total of Rs. 18,900 per tola. On Saturday alone, the price of gold fell by Rs. 3,500 per tola, bringing the rate down to Rs. 376,336 per tola.
